jobs.description:
For an international company active in the automotive sector, we are looking for a passionate and proactive Communication Officer. The company specializes in innovative vehicle solutions and operates across several international markets.You will join an international environment where communication plays an important role in showcasing the company's expertise, projects and solutions. You will work closely with different teams and have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to life.

Jobomschrijving

Your responsibilities

• You develop and create a wide range of communication materials, including brochures, presentations, newsletters, product content and social media posts.
• You manage the company's social media channels and create engaging photo and video content, taking ownership of the entire process from the initial idea to publication.
• You coordinate website content, translate technical information into accessible communication and ensure a consistent brand identity across all channels.
• You work closely with marketing, sales, operations and international colleagues, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve the company's communication and digital presence.

Your profile

• You have at least a first experience in a general communication or marketing role and are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.
• You are genuinely passionate about communication and content creation. You take initiative, think ahead and don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done. You identify opportunities, come up with ideas and turn them into concrete actions.
• You have a hands-on mentality, work independently and take ownership of your projects. You are creative, organized and detail-oriented, with a good eye for visual content and brand consistency.
• You have experience with social media, graphic content and photo and video editing. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, Lightroom and CapCut is a plus.
• You are curious about digital communication and new technologies, and enjoy finding ways to improve existing processes and content.
• You have a valid driving licence (B) and are willing to travel between the Belgian offices in Antwerp and Brussels and occasionally abroad. You are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow and make a real impact.

Our client is a leading international logistics group operating within the temperature-controlled supply chain sector. Active across multiple European markets, the company combines operational excellence, strong financial backing, automation, and ambitious growth plans. The environment is dynamic, entrepreneurial, performance-driven, and focused on continuous improvement and innovation

Jobomschrijving

• Define and execute the facilities, maintenance, and engineering strategy across key operational sites.
• Ensure maximum equipment availability, reliability, and operational continuity.
• Lead preventive and corrective maintenance programmes for automated infrastructure and technical assets.
• Manage engineering teams, external contractors, and specialised service providers.
• Develop and monitor maintenance KPIs, budgets, and performance standards.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and reduce downtime.
• Oversee major capital expenditure projects, site upgrades, and infrastructure investments.
• Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, regulatory, and quality requirements.
• Support automation initiatives and technological enhancements across operations.
• Collaborate closely with operations, finance, procurement, and executive leadership teams.

• Degree in Engineering, Industrial Maintenance, Electromechanics, Facilities Management, or related discipline.
• Extensive leadership experience within logistics, manufacturing, industrial, automated warehousing, cold chain, or similar asset-intensive environments.
• Strong expertise in maintenance management, engineering operations, and technical infrastructure.
• Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and major investment projects.
• Proven capability to manage budgets, suppliers, and performance improvement programmes.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication capabilities.
• Fluent English required; additional European languages are considered an advantage.
• Comfortable operating within a fast-growing, international organisation.

Our client is a leading professional services organization operating a network of accounting and advisory offices across Belgium. Driven by strong growth ambitions and a continuous focus on innovation, the company has invested significantly in digital transformation, process excellence, and modern technologies to support both its employees and clients.As part of its long-term strategy, the company is building a future-oriented environment where technology and people work hand in hand. The Digital Team plays a key role in this journey by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, standardize ways of working, and unlock the potential of emerging technologies across the business.To support this journey, they are seeking a Digital & Process Expert (AI) to play a key role in shaping and delivering their digital transformation initiatives.

Jobomschrijving

As a Digital Expert, you will play a central role in shaping and accelerating the organization's digital and AI transformation agenda.Your responsibilities will include:

• Analyzing existing business processes across accounting offices and identifying opportunities for optimization, standardization, and automation.
• Defining future-state processes and selecting the most appropriate technologies to support them.
• Driving the adoption of digital tools such as accounting, reporting, workflow, and collaboration platforms.
• Identifying and implementing AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, reduce manual work, and improve service quality.
• Monitoring emerging trends in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, automation, and digital innovation, and translating these into concrete business opportunities.
• Designing and coordinating change management and implementation strategies for large-scale transformation projects.
• Acting as a trusted advisor to management and business stakeholders regarding digitalization initiatives and process improvements.
• Collaborating closely with key users and local offices to ensure successful adoption of new technologies.
• Supporting continuous improvement initiatives through feedback collection, process reviews, and performance monitoring.
• Building and facilitating internal communities to share best practices, success stories, and knowledge related to digital tools and AI applications.
• Serving as the link between operational teams, leadership, and technology partners to ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable business value.
This position combines business analysis, process improvement, technology consulting, AI enablement, and change management in a highly visible role.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with a genuine passion for technology, digital innovation, and Artificial Intelligence.You are likely to bring:

• Several years of experience in a digital transformation, business analysis, process improvement, consulting, or change management role.
• A solid understanding of accounting workflows, financial processes, or professional services environments. Experience within accountancy is considered a strong asset.
• A strong interest in AI technologies and their practical application in business environments.
• Experience working with digital platforms, workflow tools, automation solutions, or business software ecosystems.
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to identify inefficiencies and translate complex challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• A collaborative mindset and the ability to engage users at all levels of the organization.
• A pragmatic and hands-on approach, balancing long-term strategic objectives with short-term business needs.
• The ability to explain complex technological concepts, including AI-related topics, in a simple and accessible manner.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset.
• Willingness to travel regularly to various offices and work closely with local teams.
• Professional proficiency in Dutch and English, with French considered a valuable asset.
Most importantly, you enjoy helping people embrace change and are motivated by the opportunity to make technology and AI create tangible business impact.

A leading international food manufacturer which operates in a fast-moving consumer goods environment and manages a portfolio of well-known consumer brands with strong market recognition.The organization places a strong emphasis on sustainability, quality, and consumer-centric strategies.In Belgium, it collaborates closely with major retailers, distributors, and foodservice partners to strengthen its market presence.

Jobomschrijving

The Key Account Manager FMCG will be in charge of the following responsibilities :

• Manage and develop relationships with major retail and strategic accounts.
• Lead the negotiation of annual agreements, pricing, promotional plans, and commercial terms.
• Build and implement joint business plans to achieve revenue, profitability, and market share objectives.
• Identify growth opportunities and develop account-specific strategies to maximize performance.
• Monitor sales performance, customer profitability, and category trends through data-driven analysis.
• Forecast sales accurately and manage account budgets effectively.
• Conduct regular business reviews with customers and present recommendations to drive growth.
• Track competitor activity, market developments, and consumer trends to inform commercial decisions.

• At least 3 years of experience in Key Account Management, Category management, Trade Marketing or Customer Development within FMCG sector.
• Excellent negotiation, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
• Highly results-oriented with a proactive and entrepreneurial approach.
• Fluent in French or Dutch with a good comprehension of the other national language. English mandatory.

The company is a leading player in waste management, specialising in the sorting, processing and recycling of various waste streams. It continuously invests in new technologies to efficiently separate recyclable materials within a circular economy.Multiple sites are located across Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do as a Hooklift Truck Driver?

• Transport, collect and place roll-off containers at customer locations
• Secure containers with cover nets or tarps to ensure safe transport
• Alternate between driving and manual work on-site
• Respond to customer questions in a friendly and professional manner

What are we looking for in a Driver C/CE with Hooklift Experience?

• Driving licence C or CE; only C but motivated to drive with a trailer? CE can be obtained internally
• Experience as a driver is an advantage but not required
• You are an early starter (between 4 a.m. and 6 a.m.)
• You speak Dutch, English or French for safety instructions

Our client is a well-established, renowned non-profit advocacy organization with a long-standing commitment to its core mission.They focus on raising public awareness, influencing policy, and driving meaningful change to advance welfare and rights.

Jobomschrijving

As Head of Communications, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Mix of strategic planning and hands-on execution, including planning major campaigns while managing daily communication activities.
• Direct involvement in content creation (press releases, social media copy, newsletters, campaigns).
• Oversight of all communication channels (website, social media, newsletters, print), with internal coordination across functions.
• Team management 
• Regular collaboration with external agencies and partners.
• Strong focus on creativity and innovation, combined with agency-driven input.
• Budget management.
• Fast-paced, reactive environment requiring also reporting and performance tracking.

• At least 3 years of professional experience in a marketing position
• Able to manage projects, budgets, and teams (leadership and teamwork skills)
• Strong command of digital marketing tools, web analytics, and marketing techniques
• Knowledge of various marketing channels (social media, press relations, advertising, etc.) and how to use them effectively depending on the target audience
• Excellent writing skills
• Fluent in Dutch & French mandatory, with good command of English

Our client is an international organisation operating within a highly regulated and innovative industry. From its European hub in Brussels, the company supports customers across multiple European markets, delivering high-quality solutions and services while maintaining a strong focus on customer satisfaction, collaboration, and operational excellence.

Jobomschrijving

Invoicing & Financial Administration

• Prepare, verify, and process invoices for customer service activities across European markets.
• Review work orders, service reports, and supporting documentation prior to invoicing.
• Follow up on missing, incomplete, or inaccurate information.
• Collaborate closely with Finance to ensure accurate and timely billing.
Administrative Support

• Maintain and update administrative records and documentation.
• Ensure data accuracy within ERP and CRM systems.
• Provide administrative support to Customer Experience and Customer Care teams.
• Prepare, monitor, and manage a variety of operational documents and reports.
Supply Chain & Warehouse Support

• Provide administrative back-up for spare parts order processing.
• Support logistics and warehouse administration activities.
• Assist with shipment documentation and transportation-related paperwork.
• Act as a flexible support resource during peak periods or colleague absences.
International Coordination

• Communicate regularly with customers and colleagues across Europe.
• Support cross-functional collaboration between various departments and countries.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in an administrative, customer service, or commercial support role.
• Experience with invoicing or billing processes is a strong advantage.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Customer-oriented mindset and effective communication skills.
• Ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
• Flexible, proactive, and supportive team player.
• Capable of working independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
• Experience with ERP systems is an advantage; SAP knowledge is considered a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and French
• Knowledge of German is highly desirable
• Good level of English

Our client is a fast-growing B2B organization investing heavily in the optimization of its digital landscape. As part of this transformation, they are looking for a Freelance IT Business Process Lead to analyze, redesign, and document key business processes, with a strong focus on e-commerce and IT systems.

Jobomschrijving

As a Freelance Business Process Lead your responsibilities are:

• Analyze and map end-to-end business processes across multiple departments.
• Assess the interaction between business processes and IT systems.
• Redesign and optimize workflows to improve efficiency, scalability, and user experience.
• Document business processes, functional flows, and system interactions.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into functional process designs.
• Act as the interface between Business, IT, and external implementation partners.
• Support digital transformation projects related to e-commerce platforms and business applications.
• Ensure process governance, standardization, and adoption across the organization.
• Identify opportunities for automation and continuous process improvement.

A successful Freelance Business Process Lead should have:

• Proven experience as an IT Business Process Lead, Functional Analyst, or Process Consultant.
• Mandatory experience within a B2B e-commerce environment.
• Hand-on experience with Shopify or Magento is a great advantage.
• Strong understanding of business processes, system integrations, and digital workflows.
• Experience documenting business processes, functional specifications, and user journeys.
• Fluent in French and English.

One of the most important players in the bank sector in Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

In charge of the control of KYC files : based on local and cross-border requirements and internal  process:

Collaboration with the KYC Coordinator, the Middle office and/or with compliance departments to discuss potential issues and find solutions.Communicate on the progress  (and in case of potential difficulties)  with the team leader.Communications to colleagues will be done in French, Dutch or English.

An international manufacturing organization is seeking a senior finance leader to support operational performance, profitability enhancement and strategic decision-making across a complex industrial footprint.This highly visible role combines financial leadership, operational analysis and performance management, while partnering with senior stakeholders to drive sustainable business results.The successful candidate will operate at the crossroads of finance and operations, providing meaningful insight, challenge and support to business leaders within a dynamic and evolving industrial environment.

Jobomschrijving

Head of Plant Controlling - EuropeYou will play a central role in monitoring and driving operational performance, helping business leaders translate industrial activities into measurable financial outcomes.Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, you will contribute to both short-term performance delivery and long-term value creation initiatives.Key responsibilities include:

• Driving financial and operational performance management across manufacturing activities
• Leading budgeting, forecasting and strategic planning processes for industrial operations
• Identifying opportunities to improve profitability, productivity and resource allocation
• Analyzing cost structures, operational efficiencies and key performance drivers
• Supporting business leaders through data-driven recommendations and robust financial insights
• Challenging assumptions and influencing decision-making through fact-based analysis
• Developing and enhancing performance management tools, reporting frameworks and financial governance practices
• Supporting investment evaluations, business cases and transformation initiatives
• Monitoring operational risks and ensuring appropriate financial controls are in place
• Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening business performance
• Collaborating with finance and operational teams across multiple locations and functions.

Head of Plant Controlling - EuropeWe are looking for a seasoned finance professional who combines strong analytical capabilities with a genuine understanding of industrial operations.You bring:

• Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering or Business Administration
• Strong leadership skills
• Significant experience in industrial finance, controlling or performance management within a manufacturing environment
• Strong understanding of cost management, profitability analysis and operational performance measurement
• Experience operating in international and matrix organizations
• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and challenge constructively
• Strong business acumen coupled with excellent analytical skills
• Ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations
• Experience supporting operational and strategic decision-making
• Excellent communication and presentation skills
• Fluency in English with knowledge of French and/or Dutch
• Open to travel occasionally.

Our client is a fast-growing international healthcare company, combining pharmaceutical expertise with global supply and service capabilities.

Jobomschrijving

• Supporting external audits and acting as the key contact for auditors.
• Preparing audit schedules and year-end statutory accounts.
• Ensuring compliance with local GAAP, IFRS, or other statutory reporting requirements.
• Coordinating audit timelines and resolving audit queries efficiently.
• Performing month end for all aspects of the management accounts
• Ensuring financial processing and authorisation procedures are applied in accordance with approved procedures
• Assisting in the preparation of statutory financial statements for relevant entity in accordance with Local Accounting Standards
• Preparing tax related declarations e.g. VAT, Intrastat and Corporate tax
• Supporting initiatives to obtain tax subsidies

• Degree in a related subject
• Demonstrable audit experience
• Successful track record gained in a similar environment
• Knowledge of in-house finance processes and practices advantageous
• Advanced Excel
• Business level English & French is essential
• Ability to understand and communicate financial matters relating to the Business Units
• Knowledge of IFRS
• Strategic thinker, with the ability to define objectives and develop frameworks
• Ability to work both collaboratively as part of a global team, in an ambiguous, constantly changing environment

Our client is an international industrial company operating a complex manufacturing environment with a strong focus on operational excellence and energy efficiency.

Jobomschrijving

• Analyze electrical energy consumption and identify optimization opportunities across the site.
• Conduct electrical studies and calculations (load flow, short-circuit, selectivity) and develop electrical schematics using EPLAN in compliance with applicable standards.
• Identify, develop, and implement energy-saving projects related to electrical distribution, lighting, motors, drives, and network infrastructure.
• Coordinate electrical network improvement projects, ensuring proper documentation, safety compliance, and stakeholder alignment.
• Manage electrical documentation, inspection plans, and emergency power systems while reporting progress and recommendations to management.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Energy Engineering, Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in energy management or electrical engineering within an industrial environment.
• Strong analytical mindset with a genuine interest in sustainability and energy optimization.
• Solid knowledge of high-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems, energy regulations, and industrial compliance requirements.
• Autonomous, proactive, solution-oriented, and able to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
• Fluent in Dutch and English

Our client is a leading international organisation operating within the real estate, construction, and professional services sector. With a strong global presence and a reputation for excellence, the company delivers innovative property solutions in a collaborative, diverse, and forward-thinking environment focused on operational excellence and sustainable growth.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead the end-to-end delivery of design and construction projects
• Establish and manage project budgets, forecasting, and funding requests
• Build and lead multidisciplinary project teams
• Manage procurement processes for consultants, contractors, and suppliers
• Coordinate internal and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle
• Monitor project performance, KPIs, reporting, and governance processes
• Lead change management activities and manage project modifications
• Conduct contractor evaluations, tender reviews, and award recommendations

• Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, or related discipline
• Minimum 5 years of experience in project management within construction, engineering, real estate, or a related environment
• Proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
• Demonstrated leadership and team management experience
• Fluent in English and French or Dutch

Join a dynamic and fast-growing international company where innovation, entrepreneurship, and ambition are at the heart of everything. You'll have the opportunity to build a global network, make a real impact, and accelerate your career in an inspiring environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients.
• Develop and manage your own client portfolio.
• Identify and approach new business opportunities.
• Understand clients' needs and provide tailored solutions.
• Conduct market research and monitor industry trends.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer satisfaction.
• Represent the company during meetings, events, and client visits.

• Bachelor's degree minimum.
• Fluent in French or Dutch, with a good command of English.
• Ambitious, energetic, and driven by results.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Not afraid of client contact or commercial challenges.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive attitude.
• Eager to learn and build a successful career in sales and account management.

Zij zijn een innovatieve en groeiende speler in de verse voedingssector, waar kwaliteit, duurzaamheid en teamwork centraal staan. In een dynamische omgeving krijg je de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Samen bouwen ze elke dag aan sterke resultaten én een succesvolle toekomst.

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Shift Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily operations of a modern packaging and production department. You lead a team of approximately 150 employees across multiple packaging lines and ensure that production targets, quality standards and customer requirements are achieved efficiently and safely.

You are a visible leader on the shop floor, coaching and supporting your team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and performance.

What will you do?

• Lead and support a large operational team, including direct supervision of team leaders.
• Monitor production planning, quality, safety and productivity targets.
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics and maintenance teams to ensure smooth daily operations.
• Follow up on employee performance, coaching and development.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.
• Ensure products meet the highest quality standards and customer expectations.

Who are you?

• You have experience in a supervisory role within a production, packaging or food manufacturing environment.
• You are a strong people manager who can motivate, coach and develop teams.
• You remain calm under pressure and can effectively prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• You have an interest in production processes and a willingness to develop your technical knowledge.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English; knowledge of Romanian is an asset.
• You are quality-focused, hands-on and solution-oriented.
• You understand the flexibility required in a fresh food environment where quality and customer service are key.

Place of Employment - Machelen

Jobomschrijving

Our client is an international logistics leader and is looking for an Air Export Administrative Agent to strengthen their Air Export Team in the Machelen region. 

We offer an initial fixed-term contract of 1 month, starting on 1 September, allowing sufficient time for onboarding and knowledge transfer followed by a replacement contract covering a maternity leave and subsequent absence.

The total expected assignment duration is approximately 12 months.

Your Role:

As an Air Export Administrative Agent, you will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of air export shipments while ensuring excellent customer service throughout the shipment lifecycle. You will work closely with customers, airlines, and internal departments to guarantee smooth and efficient operations. 

Key Responsibilities:

Air Freight Administration

• Track and trace air export shipments through online systems and email communication.
• Manage and process shipment-related documentation accurately. 
• Upload shipment documents into electronic document management systems.
• Support the handling of shipment pre-alerts and storage requirements, including temperature-sensitive shipments. 
• Follow up on active container leasing and end-of-lease activities. 
Customer Service

• Inform customers proactively about shipment status updates and delays.
• Respond professionally to customer inquiries.
• Ensure customer requirements and operating procedures are consistently respected. 
Compliance & Operational Excellence

• Escalate operational issues to management when necessary.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency and service quality.
• Ensure compliance with company procedures, customer requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
• Follow up on operational discrepancies and system-related issues.
• Assist with claim notifications to airlines when required. 

Your Profile:

We are looking for a motivated logistics professional who thrives in a dynamic international environment.

Requirements

• Knowledge of the air freight process and transport documentation.
• A background in Transport & Logistics or a similar education is highly valued.
• Administrative experience or strong administrative skills.
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
Proactive and able to work independently. 

Good computer skills and ability to quickly learn new systems.

• Fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written).
• Strong communication skills with both customers and colleagues.
Personal Qualities

• Customer-focused and service-minded.
• Flexible and willing to go the extra mile when operational needs require it.
• No strict "9-to-5" mentality.
• Professional attitude and willingness to follow company procedures, policies, and dress code.
• Strong team player with a positive mindset.

Our client is an innovative international technology company developing advanced solutions in a highly regulated and engineering-driven environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead, coach, and support team members in their professional growth and development.
• Build and maintain a high-performing team through recruitment, onboarding, workforce planning, and retention initiatives.
• Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Ensure effective team delivery by managing capacity, workload, planning, and operational effectiveness.
• Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and other stakeholders to strengthen Agile practices and improve overall team performance.

• Proven experience in people management, team leadership, coaching, or talent development.
• Strong interpersonal, communication, and active listening skills with the ability to build trust and engagement.
• Experience working in Agile, technical, engineering, or other multidisciplinary environments.
• Ability to balance people management, operational delivery, and organizational priorities while adapting to change.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of French is considered an asset.

For a foodcompany in Meulebeke, we are looking for a line supervisor for a 2-shift schedule.

You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action
• You have some technical insight
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts
• It is a plus if you can operate a forklift

About this job
Are you comfortable taking the lead in a production environment? Do you enjoy combining people management with a strong focus on quality and efficiency? For a growing company, we are looking for a Packaging Team Leader to strengthen the operations team.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
In this role, you ensure that the packaging department operates smoothly from start to finish.

• Prepare and organize the daily packaging activities.
• Guide employees and distribute tasks across the team.
• Keep a close eye on product quality, hygiene and safety procedures.
• Follow up on packaging orders and coordinate priorities.

• A first experience in production is preferred; experience in the food industry is a strong advantage.

• You work accurately and have an eye for quality and detail.
• Good English communication skills are required.

Production Logistics Associate, Day Shift
